summary: No blocking plan defects found across source reality, architecture, quality and systems review. One implementation caution concerns preserving empty-text versus absent-response conformance evidence.

warnings.issue: The shared call helper currently rejects empty or whitespace-only text and absent/non-string content through the same malformed-response exception. Counting only successful returned strings would lose the false-versus-null distinction required by D.
warnings.evidence: At the source base, service.py:8300-8306 collapses these cases before the checkpoint provider-failure handler at 8920-8928.
warnings.resolution: Preserve a typed observation of whether textual content was received across the call boundary. Explicitly test empty and whitespace-only text against absent/non-string content, including retry behavior. The plan already requires these semantics; this is an implementation caution, not a prerequisite plan amendment.
